differences.reason: Preserve Swift async/await, Sendable, Foundation transport and existing documented gaps; see Docs/CoreV6Parity.md and PortingStatus.md.

2026-11-01: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 3.0.78 -> 3.0.82; integrity-verified published sources/declarations and matching-release tests 612be2311464804d1e4897afacbf8f3fc2f6d9e3 -> 9b603d36186b75e58d5479445a96c76f6e2d2700 reviewed independently. New native behavior is covered by Weekly20261101 suites. Internal TypeScript catalog/documentation/type-inference declarations are represented by native request policies, not an exact JS export contract. Prior imported provenance and known gaps remain unchanged. Async API key suppliers resolve before each authenticated Chat/Completion/Embedding/Image request and trusted image download, retaining explicit auth overrides and foreign-origin stripping. Add native mapReasoning callback for portable reasoning only; explicit provider reasoningEffort bypasses the callback. Misplaced completion system errors include their content.

2026-11-14 @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 3.0.87 -> 3.0.92: integrity-verified published old/latest source/declarations and exact release-matched tests 0f3a85f92d1ce06ccde01d662407ef83e097a712 -> 8bc7652cdb13fc84722666eb93f45acd0d131eee reviewed separately. Public reusable prepareRequest builds the unary JSON body plus warnings through the same reasoning, option, transformRequestBody and transformRequestBodyWithWarnings paths as generate, without a network call or streaming fields. Public convertResponse converts a detached JSON body through the same content/reasoning/refusal/tool-call/usage/raw-metadata conversion, respects camel-case provider metadata selection and rejects invalid/empty choices without HTTP metadata. Native nonoptional request/response metadata wrappers use empty defaults; rawValue is retained as the Swift raw-body contract. Configured unauthenticated download transport is additive and image inputs/masks/markup retain cancellation. The current converter remains synchronous because existing Swift extraction hooks are synchronous; JS-only workflow metadata remains out of scope. The new upstream preparation fixture also revealed portable topK was dropped without its unsupported warning; the shared native prepare/generate/stream warning path now emits it for generic compatible models.
